sections.value:
F261 / #311 deployed AFTER receipt

Measured daemon: PID 72066, commit 35dd41ac9172a27705693bdb14d91ec6dea28cee, carrying #311 and #315 (migration 0049). The selected PID, commit and process start were unchanged at both CPU endpoints and both machine-sample identity checks. Process start: Sat 21 Nov 20:10:55 2026, host-local (10:10:55Z).

Shared CPU window (SAMPLE315-V1): 2026-11-21 10:21:30.066260Z to 10:22:30.075166Z, nominal monotonic span 60.008714 s. pij-encouraging-turtle collected the shared CPU/thread/cohort/ps/load/spawn/log-stat receipt after ten minutes of daemon uptime; I verified its global fields and exact log interval. The actual /bin/ps endpoints are 60.0714015 s apart.

Exact CPU/RSS command at both endpoints: /bin/ps -p 72066 -o 'pid=,etime=,time=,rss=,lstart=', executed as a subprocess argv array with no shell, confirmed by the collector owner. The raw ps strings and ps-read monotonic edges are retained with the shared receipt. Per-site counters come from pij-rs --json ping at both endpoints.

| Measurement | Start | End / delta |
| --- | --- | --- |
| /bin/ps cumulative CPU | 2:02.32 (122.32 s) | 2:08.42 (128.42 s): +6.10 s, 10.1546% of one core |
| /bin/ps RSS | 115952 KiB | 104224 KiB |
| Load average, 1/5/15 min | 88.5386 / 72.3169 / 66.6895 | 76.7261 / 71.5649 / 66.7700 |
| Live cohort | 217 seats / 217 distinct recorded panes | unchanged |
| Harness cohort | Claude 126 / Copilot 85 / OMP 6 | unchanged; 85 native-extension-delivery rows |
| ping .data.spawns.total | 960 | 989: +29, approximately 0.48 launches/s |
| Liveness fallback | ps.proc-liveness-fallback absent (0) | still 0 |

All nonzero per-site spawn deltas in that CPU window:
- ddocs.community +2; git.community +7.
- tmux.atomically reserve staged submit +2; tmux.authorize staged submit commit +2.
- tmux.load submit buffer +6; tmux.paste owned submit buffer +6.
- tmux.restore pane input and release ownership +2; tmux.submit authorized staged body +2.

All other reported sites were flat, including ps.registration-native-process, ps.tmux-harness-process-tree, tmux.control-client and pane-tap attach. The 29 launches are existing governance/control sites, not a new F261 launch site. This was live fleet work, not an isolated no-activity benchmark.

Separate machine sample: just spawn-rate --seconds 20 --json, exit 0. Actual wrapper window 2026-11-21 10:23:54.787575Z to 10:24:15.249658Z, monotonic 20.461785 s including startup/teardown; sampler reports an internal 20.0 s window. Whole-machine rate 197.1 new processes/s; sampled 183.8/s. No direct daemon children were sampled (a lower bound, not an absolute absence proof). Independent ping checks around this sample show PID72066/35dd41ac91 unchanged and spawns1009 -> 1009, with every reported site flat. The machine sampler did not overlap the completed CPU window.

Lapse-follower observability:
- The shared log endpoints refer to the same managed daemon.log: device16777230, inode1098668404, bytes24494 -> 24494. The file still matched those identities when checked, so the exact monitored byte interval was available and empty.
- Zero gap-reconcile, follower-termination or reconciliation-read-error log markers were observed in that window. No gap-reconcile marker was present anywhere in the current managed log at inspection. The current daemon's listening marker is 10:10:56.070371Z.
- Successful attachment and reconcile completion/pass count are not emitted by this build. auth_recovery.rs:566-588 attaches and calls reconcile once before its live loop, then again only after a gap; that is code-path evidence, NOT a direct runtime certificate that the boot pass completed exactly once. These receipts establish no observed gap diagnostics, not a numerical subscriber/pass counter.
- No lapse or restart was induced. This steady-state sample does not prove the next natural unattended recovery or measure the CPU duration of boot reconciliation.

Comparison limit: R1's historical BEFORE (PID22838/653f90ef96) recorded 21.76% of one core over 20.034019 s, zero daemon launches, and a separate 352.8/s machine window that overlapped quick checks. The AFTER is a different cohort/load/window and co-deploys #315. Do not attribute the lower CPU/RSS or changed machine rate to #311 alone. The R2 new follow-up on gap-storm read cost remains: serialized scans are not a scans/second cap, and each native-seat outstanding() call performs three indexed seeks.

Collection hygiene: main was used read-only, with no build, install, edit, bounce or deliberate lease lapse. Crossed ownership messages briefly started a second global helper; I stopped only that exact job, discarded its incomplete receipt, and used none of its data. Its initial light probes overlapped the shared window; no busy machine sampler overlapped it. The shared collector and sole machine collector finished; no collectors remain.

Holding: the governed performance/311 row for pij-minimum-ocelot was already ended by the prime at 2026-11-21T10:11:23.293Z, reason "PR #311 merged (35dd41ac9172)". No open performance/311 holding remains; do not repeat a release or recreate it for this note.

Harness feedback: magicWand = a successful follower attachment/reconcile counter plus a versioned, execution-state-based shared-sample handoff. Difficulties = successful boot reconciliation is not directly observable; crossed allocation ACKs can disagree with actual collectors. Final shared ownership was SAMPLE315-V1, and runtime receipts, not stale ACKs or planned timestamps, are the authority.
